in_sanskrit.name: लीला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: लीला (Līlā) is a Sanskrit word that means play, sport, game, amusement. It refers to the joyful and creative expressions of the divine in the world, and is often used in Hindu mythology to describe the divine pastimes of gods and goddesses.

in_hindi.name: लीला
in_hindi.long_meaning: लीला (Līlā) is a Hindi name that is derived from the Sanskrit word लीला (Līlā). It has the same meaning as in Sanskrit, which is play, sport, game, amusement.

in_tamil.name: லீலா
in_tamil.long_meaning: லீலா (Līlā) is a Tamil name that can be translated as 'play, sport, game' or 'amusement, entertainment'. It is derived from the Tamil word கலை (kalai), which means 'play, game, sport'.

in_telugu.name: లీలా
in_telugu.long_meaning: లీలా (Līlā) is a Telugu name that means 'lively, playful, and divine'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word लीला (Līlā), which means 'play, sport, game, amusement'.
